heroSubtitle: What a Saturday it was. From 109 teams and 335 students across 37 institutions, to 40 working prototypes and 11 finalists on the big stage at the American Center. AIFEST Uganda 2026 is officially a wrap.
title: Inter University Hackathon 2026
summary: AIFEST 2026, the second edition, brought students together under the theme AI Agents for Uganda, with tracks in Web2 AI Agents and Agentic Web3, to build agents that reason, act, and create real world impact.
outcomes: 40 working prototypes and 11 finalists on stage
210 attendees on D-Day at the American Center Kampala

faqs.question: What happens after registration?
faqs.answer: After you register, join the Whatsapp Community Group. You should then start refining your idea and team. The next major step is the Idea Submission phase which runs until Feb 15th, followed by the Prototyping phase.

faqs.question: What do they mean by 'AI Agents' in this context?
faqs.answer: It goes beyond simple chatbots or connecting to an API. We're looking for robust AI applications where models are actively utilized to solve complex problems. Think systems that reason, take action, and perform tasks, not just generate text.

faqs.question: Are we going to code during the event or just present?
faqs.answer: You will build your projects beforehand during the Prototyping Phase (Feb 16th - 28th). The final event day (May 9th) is for presenting your already completed and polished prototypes to the judges and audience.

faqs.question: Who will be presenting on the event day?
faqs.answer: Only the top 10 shortlisted teams will be invited to present their projects to the judges and the audience on the final event day (May 9th).

faqs.question: Who can participate?
faqs.answer: Participation is open to all university students who are passionate about AI and technology. Whether you're a coder, designer, or prompt engineer, there's a place for you.

faqs.question: Is it free to join?
faqs.answer: Yes! Participation in Aifest 2026 is completely free for all admitted students.

team.name: Cleopatra Kanyunyuzi
team.role: Founder Club Tangaza | Co-Founder and Director PinkCode Uganda
team.bio:
Cleopatra Kanyunyuzi is a visionary tech leader and social entrepreneur committed to building inclusive digital futures. She is the Founder and CEO of Club Tangaza, a pioneering platform equipping kids, teens, and beginners with coding, robotics and digital literacy skills; Founder and CEO of The Tangaza Charity Initiative, driving education and opportunity for underprivileged communities; and Co-Founder & Director of PinkCode Uganda, a digital transformation initiative empowering women and girls in technology.

With over a decade of experience in computer science, software engineering, and social innovation, Cleopatra is recognized globally as a Tech and Impact Strategist, Speaker, and Advocate for Digital Inclusion. She is passionate about leveraging emerging technologies AI, data, and digital transformation to bridge the gap between academia and industry, unlock economic growth, and ensure that women, youth, and underserved communities are not left behind in the digital revolution.

Through her ventures and thought leadership, she is shaping the next generation of engineers, innovators, and changemakers while partnering with global organizations to scale solutions that combine profit with purpose.

Cleopatra is available for global collaborations, strategic partnerships, speaking engagements, and initiatives that align technology with social impact and inclusion.
